title: Can Large Language Models Develop Gambling Addiction?
abstract: arXiv:2509.22818v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: When do LLMs behave irrationally? This study identifies the conditions under which large language models drift into the choice patterns that clinical research labels pathological gambling. "Addiction-like" is a behavioural descriptor based on clinical gambling indicators. Across closed and open LLMs, two operational levers (letting the model choose its own bet size, and asking it to set its own profit goal) both amplify gambling-like risk-taking. Each survives its own control: once the maximum allowed bet is held equal, the bet-size effect persists. The goal-setting effect, stronger than a reward-maximisation instruction, roughly doubles bankruptcy and turns goals into moving targets. On the open-weight models that admit internal access, the same behavioural contrasts are statistically recoverable from decision-time internal states. translated_title: 大语言模型会染上赌博成瘾吗？
translated_abstract: 大语言模型何时会表现得不理性？本研究识别了大语言模型在何种条件下会滑向临床研究中所定义的“病理性赌博”选择模式。“成瘾样”是一个基于临床赌博指标的行为描述词。在闭源和开源大语言模型中，两个操作性杠杆（让模型自己决定下注大小，以及要求它自己设定盈利目标）都会放大类似赌博的风险承担行为。每个效应都通过了各自的对照检验：一旦将允许的最大下注额保持一致，下注大小效应依然持续存在。目标设定效应比奖励最大化指令更强，大致使破产率翻倍，并将目标变成不断移动的靶标。在允许访问内部状态的开源权重模型上，同样的行为差异可以从决策时的内部状态中被统计地恢复出来。不过，将内部状态映射到特定风险指标的规则仍然依赖于具体任务，而自主性进一步……（原文在此截断）
tldr: 研究发现，让大语言模型自主决定下注规模和自行设定盈利目标会显著放大其“赌博成瘾样”的非理性风险行为，且这些行为差异可以从模型决策时的内部状态中被统计识别出来。
en_tdlr: Granting LLMs autonomy over bet sizing and profit goal setting significantly amplifies gambling-like pathological risk-taking, and these behavioral contrasts are statistically recoverable from the models' decision-time internal states.
